balls.text: just six runs off the last over, and that is a terrific comeback by Pathirana! Zipped in very full again, right at the stumps. Pandey cannot get under it despite advancing and cloths it towards mid off. Only a single and KKR will finish with 179!
another slower delivery that ends up as a full toss on the stumps. Ramandeep has a swish at it and whips it away towards fine leg
slower low full toss on the thighs. Pandey gets inside the line and helps it down to fine leg. Just a single

Dhoni gets a glove to it but cannot hold on! This is a searing leg-stump yorker. Ramandeep gets across his stumps and glances it fine. Dhoni flings out his left mitt and parries it towards deep backward square
zipped into the blockhole on leg stump. Pandey backs away and drills it towards mid off. Ashwin fields it in leisurely fashion and does not even contemplate a shy at the bowler's end
very full just outside off. Ramandeep sits deep in his crease and drives it down the ground towards long on
tossed up full just outside off. Pandey plants his front foot and shanks it back to the bowler. Pandey will be disappointed with that attempt
splits the field perfectly! A bit of a drag-down on middle and leg and this sits up to be hit. Pandey picks the length early and hammers it between long on and deep mid wicket!
darted in full but also down leg. Pandey looks to help it fine with a swat but misses. Dhoni gets his pad in the way, and the umpire calls it a wide
googly on a back of a length on the stumps. Ramandeep stays back and taps it gently into the point region to get off the mark

a juggling act on the fence, but Mhatre gets the job done! Short and sliding into the hips. Rinku sits deep in his crease and heaves it towards deep backward square leg. Mhatre gets into a good position right on the fence but loses control of the ball as he tries to catch it first. But he has the awareness to track where the ball goes, and gobbles up the second chance with a nonchalant fling of the right mitt, while also holding his balance and staying away from the boundary cushion. Wicket number four for Noor tonight!

shortens the length just outside off as Rinku shapes for another reverse. He swipes at thin air this time, with the ball rolling off his body into the on side. Pandey wanted the single and gets sent back
brilliant batting! Fired in full just outside off. Rinku brings out the reverse and nails it over backward point. Clarity of thought, and dexterity in execution!

oh dear! This is a borderline waist-high full toss outside off. Rinku uses the pace and dabs it down to deep backward point. The umpires are happy with it, and Rinku does not challenge the umpire's call for the second ball in a row

nails the wide yorker and the ball seems to just sneak inside the tramlines too. Left alone by Rinku and not called a wide. But after some deliberation, Rinku reviews. Rinku is standing in his normal stance, and the replay shows some part of the ball is inside the tramlines. Original call stands, and KKR lose a review!
Rinku begins with a boundary! Juicy full toss on middle and off. Rinku opens his bat face a touch and he steers it past short third!
another slot ball outside off. Pandey backs away and drills it straight to extra cover. He will feel he missed out there, especially with mid off also up
Pandey into the six-hitting act now! Right in the slot on middle and off, and that is just what Pandey wants. He sits deep in his crease, opens up his front hip and clubs it over wide long on!
banged into the track on middle and off, Pandey gives himself room and flat-bats it over the bowler's head for a couple of runs

Russell swats it flat, but straight to Brevis! Noor breaks through and that is a massive wicket! Another googly, although this is shorter outside off. Russell looks to pummel it over long off but does not get the elevation he wants. The ball gets lost in the lights for a bit but Brevis keeps his eyes on it very well. Swoops down low to complete the catch in the end, and Russell is disconsolate as he walks back. Noor and CSK, meanwhile, cannot control their delight!
Russell goes into the stands! Googly on a length on middle and off. Russell takes a giant step back and across to set himself up and smears it over deep mid wicket!
back of a length on the stumps and this grips in the surface. Spins away sharply and breezes past the outside edge of Russell's dangling blade

Watch. The. Spin. Devon. Conway. Floated up full just outside off. Russell plants his front foot again and slices it towards deep extra cover. Conway over-runs it and then watches in horror as the ball spins to his left!
peach! Googly on a length on leg stump. Russell does not know where this is turning and plants his front foot to poke at it. Beaten all ends up on the outside
fired in down leg. Pandey looks to help that on its way and only finds short fine leg
zipped in full on middle and off. Pandey backs away early and squeezes it out towards extra cover
length just outside off. Pandey clears his front leg and drills it back past the bowler. Good work by Brevis at long on to keep it to two
attempted slower yorker that ends up as a low full toss on the pads. Russell plays a week early and the ball pings off his back leg towards fine leg
Dre Russ is in the house, folks! Slow, short and wide outside off. Russell reaches out for it and then manufactures enough power to slam it over extra cover!
smashed! Off-pace and into the track but this time, Russell knows exactly what is coming. Spots the variation early and thunders it flat over deep mid wicket!
banged into the track just outside off and that takes Russell by surprise. He was setting up for the full ball and had to let it go in the end
back of a length, angling into off stump. Skids on and tucks the batter up, who is forced to jab it straight to backward point
pushed in on a length on the stumps. Russell gets his front foot out of the way and swipes it towards deep mid wicket
Russell goes massive! Angled in on a length on middle and leg. Russell plants his front foot, swings through the line and clobbers it over long on!

back to back boundaries! Darted in on a back of a length on middle and off. Russell gets himself into a bit of a tangle initially but those strong forearms come through in the end, swatting it past deep mid wicket, despite Noor's sprawl to his right!
edged and four! Given a bit more air and pushed in fuller on middle and off. Russell has an almighty swipe across the line and gets a thick outside edge that flies over slip!
back of a length, honing into off stump. Russell is happy to hang back and defend (for now)
full again, attacking the stumps. Russell gets his front foot out of the way and drills it towards long on, stationed straighter than normal
excellent slower yorker on middle stump. Pandey clinks it out past the bowler and picks up another single
another top yorker, sizzling into leg stump. Russell jams down on it in time and squirts it away towards deep square leg. Russell nearly lost his balance trying to play that
searing yorker that tails into the toes, well outside leg. Pandey jams down on it and squeezes it out towards deep square leg
dug into the track on leg stump. Russell uses the pace on offer and whips it away towards fine leg
off-pace on a back of a length on leg stump. Pandey taps it just enough to the bowler's right and picks up a single
peach! Plenty of revs on this and the ball, after pitching on a back of a length just outside off, grips. Spins sharply and that beats Russell on the outside
fired in again, on a length on middle and leg. Tucked up for room, Russell pats it into the on side
on a length outside off. Russell goes feeling for it a little and the ball straightens just a shade to go past the outside edge
slanted in full on middle stump. Russell comes forward and blocks

gone this time, and Jadeja has his man! This is perhaps a little slower, angling into middle stump. Rahane shapes for the reverse, aiming to go with the turn but the ball keeps coming back into him. He cannot free his arms as much as he would have liked and that rids him of the requisite power. Spoons it straight to Conway at backward point, who makes no mistake, and it is a cacophony of noise out there at the Eden Gardens as the home side lose their skipper!

a direct hit and it would have been curtains for Rahane! Fired in full on the pads. Rahane pokes it to the bowler's right and sets off. Jadeja hurtles to the ball, picks it up but misses his shy at the bowler's end. Concedes an overthrow too for his troubles

great effort, but that may have fallen just short! Carrom ball on a full length on off. Pandey clears his front leg and slugs at it. Arrows it flat towards Mhatre at long on, who dives forward but cannot quite get there. Fell short, despite his best efforts
tossed up full on middle and off. Pandey lunges forward and pokes it back to the bowler

darted in fuller on middle and leg. Rahane looks for the slog sweep and misses. The ball brushes the pad and rolls away towards short fine leg. Dhoni appealed but Ashwin suggests it might be heading down leg
another carrom ball on a back of a length just outside off. Rahane shapes for the paddle-sweep but the lack of pace off the surface, plus the spin, beats him. Gets pinged on the body
carrom ball on a back of a length on leg stump. Straightens off the surface and Pandey drops it into the on side for a single
back of a length just outside off. Skids off the surface and Pandey hurriedly plays it back to the bowler
fullish outside off. Pandey jabs it towards point and gets called through for the single. Has to hustle a bit but makes it comfortably enough int he end
back of a length just outside off. Rahane goes back and taps it towards backward point for another single
absolute ripper! Fizzed in on a back of a length on middle and off. Drifts in, grips and then rags away past the outside edge. Rahane opened up like a deck chair
fired in full just outside off. Pandey knocks it down the ground to long off
angled in full on middle and leg. Rahane works it towards deep mid wicket and has to be content with a single
that is an amazing shot! Darted in on a back of a length on middle and off. Rahane gives himself room, holds his shape and goes through the line to cream it over long off!
shortish outside off, spinning away. Rahane hangs back and jabs it towards deep point. Seven runs off that over with minimal risk taken. KKR will not mind it
safe! Given a bit of air on a full length just outside off and that tempts Pandey into a big shot. Does not middle it, though, and it goes on the bounce to Mhatre at long on
fired in fuller on the pads. Pandey uses his wrists and glances it to short fine leg's left. Khaleel comes around from deep backward square leg, puts in the dive and saves two
flighted up full on leg stump. Rahane gets to the pitch of the ball and whisks it towards deep mid wicket
googly on a back of a length outside off. Pandey stays back and punches it towards deep point
back of a length on the stumps. Rahane waits for the ball to arrive before knocking it to long on
back of a length on leg stump. Rahane hangs back and turns it towards deep backward square leg. He wanted two but Pandey said no
slowed up on a full length outside off. Pandey reaches out for it away from his body and pushes it towards extra cover
slanted in full on leg stump. Rahane presses onto the front foot and nudges it into the mid wicket region
angled into the pads. Pandey works it towards deep backward square leg
back of a length just outside off. Pandey hops back, creates room for himself and punches it enough to sweeper cover's left for a couple of runs
full outside off. Rahane gets onto the front foot and drives it towards sweeper cover
darted in full on the pads. Rahane comes forward and eases it towards deep mid wicket
tossed up full on middle and off. Pandey goes searching for it too and slices it off the outside edge towards backward point. Good work by Jadeja in the ring

nicked and gone! The Noor Magic Show is premiering at the Eden Gardens! This is floated up beautifully on a fullish length outside off. Raghuvanshi does not know where this is going to turn and goes feeling for it. The ball spins away just a smidgen and that helps the ball kiss the outside edge. Sharp grab by Dhoni to his right, and Noor is absolutely pumped!
short and wide outside off. Rahane hops back and cuts it towards sweeper cover
fizzed in very full on leg stump. Raghuvanshi gets down on the sweep very early and paddles it towards short fine leg. Dangerous game that, Angkrish!

Dhoni whips off the bails, but was he quick enough?! Angled in on a fullish length on middle and leg. Narine advances and has a slog across the line. Misses it and the ball lodges into his back thigh before rolling towards the keeper. Narine loses his bearing and as it turns out, loses his wicket soon after. Was Dhoni quick enough? Well, of course he was. Two dismissals in two balls against Narine for Noor in T20 cricket, and CSK have their second!
given a bit of air on a full length outside off. Rahane, beaten in the flight a touch, has to reach out in front and slices it towards backward point
another full delivery, this time on the pads. Narine tucks it away towards deep mid wicket
darted in on a back of a length outside off. Spins away considerably and Narine lets it go
oh! Back of a length delivery on the pads. Narine looks to work it away but ends up nutmegging himself. A few Arsenal fans might not mind that later tonight...
tossed up full on middle and off. Rahane comes forward and works it towards deep backward square leg
fired in on a length outside off. Rahane hangs back and plays for the turn but the ball goes on with the arm to sneak past the outside edge
very full again, on middle and leg. Rahane plonks it out towards extra cover and scurries across to retain strike
into the blockhole on leg stump. Narine digs it out towards mid off and saunters across to the other end
four more! CSK leaking runs left, right and centre now! Full on the pads and with fine leg up, that is a real hit-me ball. Narine snaps his wrists into action and helps it past short fine leg!
slanted in on a length on off. Rahane presses half forward and stabs it towards mid on
shot! Fullish outside off and Rahane knows that is coming. Telegraphs it, dances down the track and lofts it cleanly over extra cover!

innovation at its best! Caught by a CSK shirt, but catches in the dugout don't count! Pushed in on a length on off. Rahane moves across early, gets down low enough and laps it clean over the fine leg fence!
oh, wow! Perhaps slower but similarly short, just outside leg, and this one spins an absolute mile to nearly go beyond the tramlines on the off side
big turn! Back of a length just outside leg and this grips in the surface to spin away appreciably. Narine swipes at it and misses
Narine is taking Ashwin down, like he has always done! Fired across the batter outside off on a back of a length. Narine sits deep in his crease and launches it over mid off!
back of a length, angled across the batter outside off. Narine backs away and slaps it towards cover, where Conway nearly over-runs it but does enough in the end to stop it
four more! Ashwin coming in for punishment yet again! Shortish just outside leg and this is not great bowling. Narine opens up his stance and hoicks it over square leg!
darted in full on the pads, and that is just what Narine needs! Uses his wrists, picks out his spot and flicks it away through square leg for four!

gets plenty of height, but not enough distance, and Pathirana hands him a reprieve! Back of a length just outside off. Rahane looks for that pick-up pull and miscues it badly. Goes so far up that it comes down with rain on it and when it does, Pathirana makes a meal of it. Seemed to misjudge it and had to reach out in front, despite the ball being in the air for a significant time. An early life for the KKR captain!
back of a length delivery hung up wide outside off. Rahane has a smear across the line but gets nowhere close to the ball. Lost his shape completely there
into the blockhole on middle and off. Narine jams down on it - not with the greatest technique cricket has ever seen - and squeezes it out into the on side
back of a length just outside off. Rahane stands up on his toes and turns it towards deep backward square leg
zipped in very full on leg stump. Narine has a swing at it having cleared his front leg and chunks it off the inside edge into his back leg. Rolls into the off side for a run
streaky but they all count! Banged into the track on the stumps. Narine hacks across the line and gets a fat top edge that flies over Dhoni's head!

more hang-time, and just enough to beat the fielders! Back of a length just outside off. Rahane steps forward and heaves at it with all his might. The ball touches the moon and comes back, and when it does, it bobbles into the deep mid wicket fence!
off-pace on a back of a length wide outside off. Rahane reaches out for it and dabs it towards backward point
and Rahane says thank you very much! Right in the slot on middle and leg, and Rahane has his first controlled boundary. Plants his front foot and slugs it over mid on!
full outside off. Rahane comes onto the front foot and pushes it towards mid off

massive lbw shout, not given! Khaleel wants the review (of course he does), but Dhoni quickly indicates it pitched outside leg! Fired in full just outside leg. Narine gets his front foot out of the way and swipes at it. Misses the ball and gets rapped on the back leg, but that pitched outside leg, with the impact also probably outside leg
slanted in full on leg stump. Narine has a wild slog across the line this time and clinks it off the toe-end towards mid on
zipped in very full but outside leg. Narine does not get bat on it and the umpire has no qualms in calling it a wide

shortish on off. Rahane lets the ball come to him before glancing it behind square. Pathirana gives chase from deep square leg, slides across and saves two. Went with his hand on the slide, rather than going with his feet like he usually does
hard length, angling into middle and off. Rahane gets up on his toes and drops it into the off side

edged and four! Length ball in the fifth stump channel and this shapes away late. Rahane prods at it but does so with soft hands, meaning that the outside edge goes to ground and then dribbles away into the deep third fence!

straight to mid wicket, and Kamboj has the last laugh! Fullish and angling into the pads. Gurbaz looks to flick it away but does not keep it down. Does not go over the fielder either and pops it straight to Noor Ahmad, stationed on the edge of the right. Easy, easy catch, and Gurbaz has to walk back for 11, despite showing a lot of intent!
oh dear! Back of a length wide outside off. Gurbaz takes a step down the track and swings like a rusty gate. The bat and the ball end up in different postcodes
goes a mile up, and goes the distance too! Length ball just outside off. Gurbaz plants his front foot, swings for the hills and clubs it over wide long on!
dug into the track outside off. Gurbaz gets up on his toes and jabs it enough to cover's left to keep strike
another play and miss! Back of a length outside off. Moves away with the angle and Gurbaz, fishing at it away from his body, is beaten again
peach! On a length in the channel and this seems to deviate away too. Gurbaz looks for the booming drive but only grabs a handful of fresh air for the second ball running
oh well! Back of a length on middle and off. Nips away a touch with the angle and Gurbaz, stepping down to smash it into the Bay of Bengal, only connects with fresh air
back of a length on middle and off. Gurbaz presses half forward and pokes at it tentatively. Jams it off the inside edge into his back thigh
off the mark straightaway! Fullish outside off and that is just the sort of length Gurbaz is after. Rocks forward and threads it between extra cover and cover!

start the tuk-tuk, we are outta here! The flourish of a man confident in his abilities, and the chase monkey is off CSK's back! It took years and years and years, and felt like an eternity, especially in an incredibly underwhelming season, but now, with MS Dhoni at the crease and with immense contributions from Dube and Brevis, they have chased down a score of 180 or above, and no, this is not a drill! This has really happened in the flesh, and it gives CSK and their fans something to smile about! Right in the slot outside off. Kamboj plants his front foot and with a short-arm jab that is senior partner at the other end would be proud of, pummels it over mid on. Smiles in the CSK camp, but the disappointment on KKR faces is discernible. Their qualification hopes now hang by the barest of threads, and they will now need something truly miraculous to get to the final four to defend the crown they won last year!

into the blockhole on middle and leg, and Dhoni squeezes this out towards extra cover. He thinks he can smuggle two and sets off but the fielding from Rahane is sharp. Dhoni has to settle for a single, and Kamboj is on strike, with the scores level!
full outside off. Dhoni plants his front foot and drills it down the ground to long off. And he does not take the single. Oh my, oh my!

MSD magic at the Eden G, and it is a racket out there all of a sudden! Russell misses the yorker and bowls a low full toss on the stumps, and MS Dhoni will have that for breakfast, lunch and dinner. Gets his front foot out of the way and biffs it over deep mid wicket!

holes out to long on, and KKR have another wicket in the penultimate over! Dug into the track outside off. Noor has a swipe across the line but the ball gets just a little big on him. Cloths it flat towards long on, where Rinku judges the catch to perfection and then lunges forward to complete it. KKR are still alive, and it will now all go down to the final over!

very full on leg stump. Noor tucks it off his pads towards deep backward square leg and hurtles back for two, getting there with a dive. Not the most glamorous dive ever in cricket, but that will do for now!

goes a mile up, and Dube does not find the distance this time! Caught superbly by Rinku and this game threatens to turn again! Another slot ball outside off and Dube cannot resist the temptation to have a pop at it, especially with mid off up. Swings his blade like an axe but cuts across the ball too much. A tame slice and Rinku back-pedals from mid off to snare the chance. Big, big moment in the game, and Dube falls for 45, having gotten CSK so close to the finish line!

Dube goes big, and the CSK fans are back to shouting their lungs out! In the arc outside off and as they say, when it is in the arc, it is out of the park. Dube loads himself up, uses his long levers and wallops it over wide long on!

much fuller but similarly wide outside off. Dube throws his hands at it and misses, and the umpire again calls it a wide. And guess what, KKR review for the second ball running. Dube has moved across a little this time, so there will be a revised guideline, but the ball is beyond the revised one too. Wide call stays!

back of a length delivery hung up wide outside off. Dube lets it go and the umpire calls ti a wide. Arora and Gurbaz think it should not be a wide, and Rahane reviews soon after. Not sure if Dube moved across to the off side. Replays suggest Dube was in his original stance, and this is really touch-and-go. A bit of the ball might be just inside the tramlines, and the call has been reversed. Oh my!
off-pace and into the track outside off. Dhoni stays leg side of the ball and cuts it towards deep point
low full toss on middle and leg. Dube gets his front foot out of the way and heaves it towards mid wicket. A dot to finish the over!
low full toss on middle and off. Dhoni drives it down the ground to long off and is happy with a single
low full toss on middle and off. Dube tugs it down the ground towards long on
low full toss just outside off. Dube gives himself a bit of room and cracks it straight to extra cover. He will feel he missed out there
low full toss just outside off. Dhoni bends his back knee and drills it back past the bowler towards long on
into the blockhole on middle stump. Dube jams down on it and squeezes it past extra cover
zipped in full on off and this tails back in a touch. Dhoni has a stab at it and chunks it off the inside edge into his front pad
low full toss on middle and leg. Dube rolls his wrists over it and works it towards deep mid wicket

clean as a whistle, and Dube lands another body blow to KKR's playoff hopes! Off-pace and in the slot, and like Rana's last over, Dube reads it very, very early. Free swing through the line and he hoists it high and handsome over long on!
slower ball on a length outside off. Dhoni waits for it and jabs it towards backward point
short and way outside off. Dhoni jumps up onto his toes and slashes at it but fails to make contact. Called a wide
angled in full on off. Dube uses his wrists and flicks it towards long on. There was initial optimism around two but that quickly fizzled out
slanted in full on middle and off. Dhoni presents the full face of the bat and punches it to long off
half-volley just outside off. Dhoni gets onto the front foot and drives it down the ground to long off. Keeps strike too
zipped in full on leg stump. Dube flicks it towards deep mid wicket and is content with a single

right in the gap, and that is a stunning shot! Banged into the track on leg stump. Dube swivels, gets on top of the bounce, while also rolling his wrists, and smacks it to deep backward square leg's right!
very full outside off. Dube opens his bat face and guides it towards backward point, where Anukul Roy, on as a sub for Chakravarthy, dives to his right and saves a boundary
off-pace and into the track outside off. Dhoni waits for it and jabs it towards extra cover for a single
full and wide outside off. Dhoni has a flat-footed waft at it away from his body and only grabs a handful of fresh air
into the blockhole just outside off. Dube digs it out towards extra cover and sets off for the single, only to be sent back by his skipper
Dube lays into Harshit Rana and takes him downtown! Seems like another change-up that lands right in the slot outside off. Dube uses those long levers and smokes it over long off!
slower ball on a full length outside off. Dhoni reads it in time and pushes it towards long off
shortish outside off. Dhoni hangs deep in his crease and cuts it straight to backward point. He will feel he missed out there
slower ball on a length outside off. Dube presses half forward and punches it towards sweeper cover
off-pace on a full length outside off. Dube reaches out for it in front and loses control of his bottom hand in the process. One-handed drive to extra cover
oh, nearly! Back of a length outside off. Skids off the surface and Dhoni, looking to cut it away, is beaten for pace
slanted in on a back of a length on middle and leg. Dube eases it down to long on
fired in on a length on leg stump. Dube plays all around it and the ball pings off his pad into the on side
full on middle and off. Dube gets onto the front foot and defends
fullish on leg stump. Dhoni comes onto the front foot and squirts it off the inside edge towards deep backward square leg
full on midde and leg. Dube gets a big stride in and knocks it to long off
angled in full on middle and off, searching for the wicket. Dhoni rocks forward and offers the full face of the bat
dug into the track just outside off. Dube opens up his stance and hacks it towards long on
short and wide outside off. Dube waits on the back foot and slaps it straight to extra cover
shortish on middle and leg. Dube waits an eternity for it before defending it towards extra cover
back of a length outside off. Dhoni goes back and jabs it into the point region to get off the mark

and Brevis bites the dust! Monumental moment in the game! Dangles the carrot on a full length on leg stump and Brevis bites. Looks to go downtown over long on but cannot get under this enough. Arrows it flat and straight to Rinku and Rinku was not going to drop that, not in a million years. A sensational knock comes to an end, and KKR have a window of opportunity again!
back of a length on off. Brevis waits on it and pats it towards backward point
full on middle and off. Dube presses forward and pokes it towards the bowler, who misfields and ends up conceding a single. Sloppy from Sunil Narine
shortish just outside off. Dube gives himself a bit of room and cuts it towards backward point
on a length outside off. Dube comes forward and opens his bat face to dab it towards backward point
back of a length outside off. Brevis goes back and eases it towards deep point. A bit of hesitation between the batters but no damage done
back of a length on leg stump. Dube lets the ball arrive before tucking it off his pads towards deep backward square leg

hold that pose, chief, and that is a 22-ball half-century for Dewald Brevis! This is off-pace but also a half-tracker that sits up. Laced with width and Brevis waits on it before obliterating it past extra cover. Everyone is up in the dugout and the yellow flags are doing overtime in the stands!
taxi, where are you?! Throw that ball back, please! Another full toss outside off and guess what happens to those - they go miles! Brevis sets up for it and bulldozes it one-handed over long on!
dead-straight, and Brevis is staring down this chase in the eye! Another low full toss just outside off. Brevis establishes a strong and solid base and thumps it over Arora's head!

watch out bowler, watch out umpire, watch out everyone! Low full toss just outside off. Brevis transfers his weight forward and blasts it over the bowler's head. Good for Arora that he did not get his hands to it. That would have flown to the fence too!
four more! This is fuller but sliding onto the pads. Brevis waits for the ball to arrive before glancing it away past short fine leg!

bursts through the hands! Right in the slot outside off. Brevis steps forward and uses his strong wrists to pump it towards long off. Raghuvanshi gets his hands up but the ball sizzles through. Too hot to handle, and Brevis gets six and a reprieve!
thrown up full and wide outside off. Dube reaches out for it and drives it between long off and deep cover for a couple of runs

appeal for a caught-behind, but the umpire is not interested! Back of a length just outside leg. Dube looks to glance it fine and seems to miss it. Gurbaz was adamant the ball had grazed something on the way, and the umpire does not call it a wide. So, Dube reviews for a wide now. Feel this is too big a risk to take, having already lost a review in similar circumstances. Nothing on UltraEdge, meaning that Dube is vindicated. But that is something CSK could refrain from!
back of a length on middle and off. Brevis gives himself a bit of room and jabs it towards sweeper cover
shorter and wider outside off. Brevis gets onto the back foot and cuts it towards backward point
back of a length on the stumps. Brevis hangs back and taps it towards backward point
back of a length just outside off. Nips away a touch and Brevis dangles his bat. Nearly chops it onto his own stumps, with the ball eventually bouncing up for the keeper to gather
tossed up full outside off. Dube plants his front foot and drags his slog towards long on
shortish outside off. Brevis backs away further and slaps it past extra cover. Dube has enough time to get back to the danger end and complete a brace, with Raghuvanshi mopping up at long off
back of a length outside off. Brevis gives himself a bit of room and jabs it towards extra cover
back of a length on middle stump. Skids onto Brevis and also spins into him. Tucked up for room, he hacks it towards mid wicket
short and dispatched! A rare long-hop by Narine and Brevis climbs into it. Opens up his front hip and belts it flat over the wide long on fence!
back of a length on middle and leg. Keeps a little low and Dube adjusts to turn it enough to mid wicket's right for a single
hard length on the stumps. Dube does not have much room to work with and stabs it off the back foot towards extra cover
back of a length outside off. Spins back a touch and Dube gets cramped on the cut. Scuffs it towards cover for a single
angled in full on off. Brevis plants his front foot and drills it down the ground to long off
slower, fuller and floatier outside off. Brevis steps forward and chips it over extra cover. Back for a brace by the time sweeper cover cuts it off
back of a length just outside off. Brevis reads it off the pitch and jabs it off the back foot towards point
on a length on leg stump. Dube turns it towards mid wicket and calls for the single. Brevis responds and hares across to complete it
fired in full on the pads. Dube works it tamely towards mid wicket

in the air and just past the fielder, and there is an eruption of noise at the Eden G! Tossed up on a fullish length and Brevis' eyes light up. He has a whoosh across the line and muscles it just enough to Ramandeep's right at deep mid wicket!
slanted in on a length on middle and leg. Brevis is cramped for room and jams it off the inside edge into his pads
shortish outside off. Dube reads the ball going away and cuts it off the back foot towards deep point

Dube with his first boundary! Short and wide outside off. Dube looks at the width and throws his hands at it, carving it past extra cover. Ramandeep gives chase from sweeper cover but cannot get there either!
back of a length on the stumps. Brevis hangs back and taps it enough to extra cover's left for a single
back of a length on middle and off. Brevis creates some room for himself on the back foot and punches it past extra cover for a couple of runs
on a length on middle and leg. Dube seems to read it off the pitch and opts to defend with soft hands in the end
full on middle and off. Dube plants his front foot and pushes it uppishly towards mid off
oh my! Googly on a fullish length just outside off. Brevis looks to pop it downtown first ball and shanks it terribly. On the bounce to long on
fired in full on the stumps. Dube pokes it towards mid off and hurtles across to the other end to get off the mark

chopped on, and Chakravarthy is into the wicket-taking action too! Jadeja departs, and CSK are now five down! Back of a length just outside off and this is an away-going delivery. Jadeja looks to dab it away but is a little early on the stroke. Gets a thick inside edge and that cannons back into the stumps. Jadeja, after a sprightly cameo, has to walk off and CSK in all sorts of trouble now!
shot! Floated up but floated up into the slot on middle and off. Jadeja plants his front foot and bangs it over the bowler's head!

in the air and taken! Ashwin bites the dust too, and CSK are four down inside five overs! Back of a length outside off. Ashwin looks to drive on the up but like Mhatre earlier in the innings, he cannot get on top of the bounce. Flays at it uppishly and Raghuvanshi is on hand at backward point to gobble up the chance. Ashwin cannot believe what he has done, but he has to trudge back, with CSK now in more than a spot of bother!
off-pace on a back of a length on leg stump. Jadeja turns it into the vacant square leg region and ambles across to the other end
banged into the track on leg stump. Rushes onto Jadeja and he helps it away past short fine leg for a brace. Might have come off the glove actually
deft, deft touch! Slower ball on a length outside off. Jadeja goes back and across, waits for the ball and then scythes it to short third's left!
bang! Jadeja lands his first punch! Back of a length on leg stump and Jadeja pre-empts the length. Marches down the track and wallops it over mid wicket!
back of a length just outside off. Jadeja gets up on his toes and meets the ball right under his eyes
angled in on a back of a length on middle and leg. Jadeja turns it towards square leg and looks at Ashwin, who responds and scurries across
back of a length just outside off. Jadeja sits deep in his crease and hurriedly jabs it towards point
back of a length, spinning in towards the pads. Ashwin eases it towards deep backward square leg
shortish outside off. Ashwin hangs deep in his crease and punches it crisply off the back foot between extra cover and cover point. Back for a brace
back of a length just outside off. Jadeja goes back and taps it towards mid on to get off the mark
flighted up full outside off. Ashwin stretches forward and works it towards deep mid wicket

flies off the outside edge and Chakravarthy snaffles it up! Fullish outside off, daring Urvil to go off-side, and this is where the youngster fails. Not for a lack of effort, though. He threw the kitchen sink and a bit more at it but just lost his shape a touch. Sharp, sharp work by Chakravarthy to his left at short third, and that, in the context of the game, looks like a big wicket!
fetch that too, says Urvil Patel! Another slower ball, on a back of a length outside off. Urvil reads it like the morning's newspaper and dumps it over wide long on!
angled in on a length on leg stump. Ashwin is a touch late on the flick and the ball dribbles off his pad into the on side
that has gone to the fence like a tracer bullet! Short and wide outside off. Ashwin rises with the bounce, stands tall and cracks it through point!
safe! Off-pace on a back of a length outside off. Urvil has a huge swipe at it and cloths it. Fortunately for him, it does not carry to Ramandeep at deep square
back of a length outside off and this skids off the surface. Urvil has a waft at it and is late on the stroke. Beaten for pace

flighted up full on off stump. Grips in the surface and spins appreciably. Well down leg in the end and not called a wide. But Ashwin wants to review this. Too early in the piece to review a wide? The third umpire says the ball would have hit the batter had he not moved across. Ashwin, for what it is worth, did take a big stride across the stumps, and CSK, just like that, burn a review! Ashwin, unsurprisingly, is not happy with the third umpire's ruling...

hot knife through butter, and Conway is outta here! Floated up beautifully on a full length on middle and off. Conway looks to drive down the ground and plays for the turn, but there isn't any. Plays down the wrong line, gets beaten on the inside and the ball crashes into the top of leg stump. Excellent bowling, and Conway has to go back without troubling the scorers!
much shorter and spinning into the hips. Urvil sits back in his crease and heaves it towards deep backward square leg
but neither can do anything, because Urvil has climbed into this too! Slower but another slot ball on middle and leg. Urvil swings at it with abandon and smears it over deep mid wicket!
thumped on the up now! This is a drag-down outside off, a clear byproduct of what happened the previous ball. Urvil waits for it and slaps it over mid off!
and Moeen gets welcomed with a maximum! Tossed up into the slot just outside off. Urvil gets down on one knee and whacks it over deep mid wicket!
full and shaping away just outside off. Conway gets onto the front foot and pushes it towards extra cover
just short! Dug into the track just outside off. Urvil stands up tall and hacks at it. Clinks it off the bottom part of the bat and that nearly carries to Rahane at mid wicket
full and swinging further down leg. Urvil does not get bat on this and the umpire has to indulge in some more exercise

oh, hello, and goodbye! This is the in-swinger and seems like Urvil has read this very early. Moves across his stumps a little to this fullish ball on middle and off, and whips it over the deep square leg fence!
short and wide outside off. Urvil throws his hands at it but only swishes at thin air

soft, soft dismissal! Oh, to be 17 and to feel this game's keen and sometimes cruel sting! Back of a length outside off, and this just sticks in the surface. Mhatre has designs to go over cover point but the lack of pace off the surface means he scuffs his shot completely. Floats it through to Rana in the ring and he makes no mistake. The perfect start for KKR, and CSK under immediate pressure!
back of a length just outside off. Mhatre hangs back, covers the slight away-swing and taps it gently into the off side
